body:
Same investigation/fix as REDGARDEN Apple #14674 -- battlegrounds_gui's own arena_game.c already had verbatim King simulation logic (confirmed by this session's own investigation) but the same wire-protocol gap. Ported protocol.h verbatim (was already byte-identical elsewhere) and patched src/main.c's snapshot-parse + render loops with the same logic REDGARDEN's apps/arena client got, adapted to this file's own line offsets. gcc -fsyntax-only clean; full mingw cross-compile (this fork's real CI target) pending CI confirmation, not verified locally (no mingw-w64 toolchain on this box). Commit 81d8076.

⚓ ☃
title: Four Kings fix ported into battlegrounds_gui
